rationale: Motor vehicle collision with significant damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injury to the policyholder; clearly within auto coverage scope.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at Route 9 red light yesterday at 8:15 AM by vehicle traveling 35 mph. The policyholder's vehicle is totaled with severe trunk/back seat damage. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other party's insurance information documented on police report. $750 deductible applies; $100k coverage limit.

case_facts.description: rear-ended at red light; other vehicle traveling 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: A tree fell on a parked vehicle causing damage to the hood and windshield; comprehensive auto coverage applies to trees falling on policyholders' own vehicles.
claim_summary: Maple tree from policyholder's front yard fell in wind and struck parked vehicle on driveway, causing damage to hood and windshield. No structural damage to home. Vehicle damage estimated in medium severity range ($2,000–$25,000). Policy includes auto comprehensive coverage with $1,000 deductible.
